author: XBOX
description:
ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut is out now on XBOX Series X|S. The espionage RPG from ZA/UM Studio, the creators of Disco Elysium, arrives on XBOX with approximately 40,000 words of new material, Backstage Mode and completed English voice-over from day one.

THE DIRECTOR'S CUT
• Approximately 40,000 words of new material
• The Quisach Roundabout: a new Dramatic Encounter featuring Hershel, Ramses, a hijacked tuk-tuk and the deceptively simple task of taking the right exit
• Backstage Mode: explore earlier iterations of selected levels, uncover cut content and hear how the game was made, narrated by Art Director Kaspar Tamsalu
• Completed and revised English voice-over
• New visual and atmospheric detail, plus expanded quality-of-life and accessibility improvements
